title: 35 Suzanne Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 35 Suzanne Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Located just a quick walk or bike ride from the sugar-white sands of 30A, 35 Suzanne Drive is a beautifully designed, pet-friendly coastal retreat offering refined comfort, elegant interiors, and the perfect setting for your next family getaway. With a private pool and spa, custom putting green, outdoor fireplace, and six adult bikes included, this home is ideal for those seeking a luxury experience near Seaside.Property Highlights Custom Private Putting Green Pet-Friendly Home (Additional Fee Applies) 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 4 Vehicles Natural Gas Grill Private Pool With Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Outdoor Fireplace Exterior Shower Quick Walk to the Beach 6-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Step into the charm and sophistication of 35 Suzanne Drive, where shiplap walls, scraped hardwood floors, and natural light create a sense of calm and coastal warmth. The open-concept main living area is thoughtfully designed for connection, with a seamless flow from the gourmet kitchen to the dining area and living room. The kitchen is a chef’s delight, featuring premium appliances including an oversized Sub-Zero refrigerator, Thermador double gas stove and oven, Dacor microwave, and a separate ice maker. The generous island invites gathering and casual dining, while the adjacent living area provides a comfortable space to relax with family and friends. Each bedroom in the home includes a private bathroom and wall-mounted television, ensuring convenience and privacy for every guest. The built-in bunk room provides a fun and practical space for children or extra guests. Outside is where this home really shines. Guests can enjoy the best of Florida living with multiple covered porches, a deck with an outdoor fireplace, a saltwater pool and spa, and a private custom putting green that’s perfect for friendly competition or practicing your short game between beach trips. Whether lounging by the pool, enjoying an evening around the fire, or lining up one more putt, the outdoor spaces offer both relaxation and recreation. Perfectly located near the beach, shops, and dining, this pet-friendly home provides effortless access to Seaside and 30A’s most beloved attractions. 35 Suzanne Drive is a haven of comfort and luxury, thoughtfully designed to make every moment of your stay memorable for the whole family.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower, Plus a Second Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub Private Office Half Bathroom Laundry Room Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4) Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo Half Bathroom Life in Seagrove Beach Located between Seaside and Eastern Lake, Seagrove Beach is known for its charming blend of natural beauty and relaxed sophistication. Guests at 35 Suzanne Drive can bike to nearby restaurants, browse Seaside’s boutiques, or enjoy a peaceful walk to the beach. With elegant interiors, resort-style outdoor living, a custom putting green, and pet-friendly comfort, this home offers the perfect balance of luxury and coastal simplicity.
